_what: P0.2 quantity register — every quantity that reaches a capital decision, declared once: one computer, one set of units, at least one surface, one assertion. Enforced by framework_integrity.quantity_register_report (Q1-Q4).
_rule_computer: EXACTLY ONE function may COMPUTE a registered quantity. A function that reads it from elsewhere and passes it on is a RELAY and does not count (Q1 distinguishes them by AST, not by grep).
_rule_null: computer:null is UNADJUDICATED and COSTS A LIVE REGISTER ITEM (ISA-0448). Writing a plausible computer where the truth is 'nobody has looked' would launder a backlog into a reassuring category.

quantities.name: underfilled_obligation_gbp
quantities.note: UNADJUDICATED by design until P4.6 ships the store. Declared here so the gap costs a live register item rather than being invisible.

register_item_superseded.why: ISA-0470 is CLOSED_FIXED (13-Sep); an UNADJUDICATED quantity must cost a LIVE item (ISA-0448). The computer adjudication belongs to the execution-owned fill-obligation store (ISA-0701, IN_PROGRESS), which names FI-QU-underfilled_obligation_gbp.

_rule_scope: key_scope declares which modules legitimately own a GENERIC key name. `target_pct` is the stock ladder rung in position_sizing and a fund's band target in fund_returns — two quantities, one key. A computer OUTSIDE the scope is reported as OUT_OF_SCOPE, never dropped: scope narrows the GATE, it never narrows the ENUMERATION. A quantity with no key_scope is scoped to the whole tree, which is the strict default.
_rule_dispositions: ISA-0695 (17-Sep-2026): finding_dispositions[<stable finding id>] = {disposition in FALSE_POSITIVE_ANALYZER|NOT_THIS_QUANTITY|SUPERSEDED (published as INFO) or TRUE_DEFECT|EXPECTED_NONLIVE|OWNED_BY|SECOND_HOME|UNRESOLVED (RED; owner ISA id required), evidence (source lines), owner, on, by}. A disposition never deletes a finding.
